title: fix(plugin-detail,app-shell): converge record:details section headings on the declared `label` slot
body:
Fixes #6190

Executes the maintainer ruling of 2026-08-31 (「同意」 through the director seat, comment 5472486816) — **option A**: three producers converge on the declared `label` slot and the consumer drops the `s.title ?? s.label` alias limb, all in one change, plus a pin that walks app-shell's real render path. B and C were not adopted. Verified on head `8a409182a`.

## Why any subset of this is a regression

`RecordDetailsRenderer` read `s.title ?? s.label` — a strict-priority second spelling of one heading slot, with byte-identical localization on both limbs, so a producer emitting both silently disagreed with itself and `title` won.

The declared and authoring faces were **already** converged on `label` and needed no change (verified on this tree): `packages/types/src/record-components.ts` declares `name` / `label` / `fields` / `collapsible` / `collapsed`, and the authoring inspector `metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` offers `name` / `label` / `columns` / `fields`. `@objectstack/spec` refuses `title` inside a `sections[]` entry (`unrecognized_keys`, pinned by objectstack#11902). Only three runtime producers lagged — and two of them are in `packages/app-shell`, outside the scope originally pinned, which is what the 2026-08-30 census found and what the ruling widened the fence to cover.

## The edit set — four sites, located by text on the merged ref

| # | Site | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:649` | `title: s.label ?? s.key` → `label: s.label ?? s.key` |
| 2 | `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:1914` | `title: sectionLabel(objectDef.name, sec.name, sec.title)` → `label: sectionLabel(objectDef.name, sec.name, sec.label)` |
| 3 | `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:1885` | the "More details" literal: `title:` → `label:` (authored in app-shell; step 1 cannot reach it) |
| 4 | `plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx:200` | `const rawTitleSrc = s.title ?? s.label;` → `const rawTitleSrc = s.label;` |

Two declarations move with the read so no declaration outlives it: `ObjectDefLike.sections` and `BuildPageOptions.sections` in the same synth file now spell the heading `label?`. Neither has a caller passing `title` (`RecordDetailView.tsx` is the only caller that passes `sections` at all).

**`DetailViewSection.title` survives untouched** — it is the renderer's OUTPUT slot (`record-details.tsx` still writes `title: translatedTitle`, consumed by `DetailSection.tsx`), not the authorable input.

### Public API — stated plainly, not as an internal refactor

`deriveFieldGroupDetailSections` is exported from `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`src/index.tsx:177`), so the **emitted key moving from `title` to `label` is an output-shape change**. The changeset says so in words, along with the retired authoring spelling, so a host grepping for the break finds it. `minor`, per this repo's fixed-group convention; never `major`.

## The measurement the ruling was widened on, reproduced here

The scope pinned before the ruling was steps 1 + 4 only. Applied alone on this tree, with the two app-shell producers left as they were:

| Shape rendered | HEAD | steps 1+4 only |
|---|---|---|
| A — synthesizer output | `Basic Information` ✅ | ✅ |
| B — app-shell re-map (`:1914`) | `Basic Information` ✅ | ✅ (survives via the `...sec` spread) |
| C — "More details" (`:1885`) | `More details` ✅ | ❌ **`details`** |

`Tests 4 failed (4)` on the new pin, with the observed failure `Unable to find an element with the text: More details` and `the literal 'details' must never stand in for the "More details" heading`. That degradation reaches **every** default record detail page whose primary/secondary split is non-empty, in every shipped locale: `detail.sectionMoreDetails` ships in all **10** locale files and **no** locale ships a `_sections.details.label` override (that key is per-object and tenant-authored only), so the fallback is load-bearing everywhere.

⛔ **NOT MEASURED**, and it stays that way: how many tenants carry such a per-object override. Under the ruled scope the question is moot.

## The new pin, and the lesson it records

`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.sectionHeadingsRenderPath-6190.test.tsx` mounts `RecordDetailView` so its assertions run over `renderedPage` — the tree the component's own comment calls "the tree actually rendered — NOT `effectivePage`". It covers both shapes the existing pin cannot reach: an object **with** `fieldGroups` plus an ungrouped trailing bucket, and an object **without** `fieldGroups` (the pure fallback path).

Its header records the one-directional-guard lesson in writing: **a red pin proves the ends are out of sync; a green pin does not prove they are in sync.** `defaultFieldGroupsPage.sectionHeadings.test.tsx` (#6241) renders `buildDefaultPageSchema(objectDef)` with no explicit sections — the plugin-detail-internal derivation — while a tenant gets `RecordDetailView`'s own section array passed *into* the synthesizer, where `resolveDetailSections` returns the caller's array verbatim. Two of the three producers are unreachable from it by construction.

Like #6241, this file asserts **rendered heading text only**, never a key spelling, so it stays invariant under any future move of the slot.

### Which assertions would still pass on a revert

Every one of them — that is the point of the design. The pin is written to be green on the unmodified tree and green after the change; what it distinguishes is a **partial** edit, and it was proven red in exactly that state (above, and again in the ablation below). #6241's pin likewise stays green untouched, as the ruling required.

## Ablations — after committing, restores hash-verified

Both mutated on disk with anchor-uniqueness and injected/removed text counts checked separately, run, then restored under `trap … EXIT INT TERM` with absolute paths; each restore proven by the blob hash equalling the HEAD blob **and** an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **R1 — restore the consumer limb alone** (all three producers stay on `label`). Predicted before running: *no visible change*, because nothing emits `title` any more and `s.title ?? s.label` falls through to `label`. Observed: `Tests 7 passed (7)` across this pin and #6241's. The limb removal is behaviourally inert once the producers moved — which is the honest measured direction, not a red.
- **R2 — restore one producer alone** (`:1885` back to `title:`). Predicted: red on the "More details" shape only. Observed: this pin `4 failed`, #6241's pin `3 passed` — the green half of the lesson above, measured on this tree.

No rebuild was needed for either and none is claimed: `vitest.config.mts:296` and `:312` alias `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell` to their `src` trees, and the pin imports `./RecordDetailView` relatively, so mutations reach the loaded modules without touching `dist`.

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='!@object-ui/site'` — `Tasks: 43 successful, 43 total`
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) — both `Done`. `--listFiles` confirms the new pin is inside the program (1 hit), so "typecheck clean" actually covers it.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/ packages/app-shell/` — `Test Files 721 passed (721)`, `Tests 6937 passed | 1 skipped (6938)`
- `pnpm exec turbo run lint` — `Tasks: 47 successful, 47 total`, `Cached: 0 cached, 47 total`; every eslint run reported `0 errors` (44 packages).
- Gates, each quoting its own verdict line: `check:control-bytes`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:sdui-registration-pins`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:eager-closure`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:skills-paths`, `check:esm-specifiers` — all exit 0. `check:sdui-registration-pins`, `check:readme-exports` and `check:eager-closure` were run only **after** the console build; before it they reported their own missing-prerequisite exits, which are not passes and were not read as measurements.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — `✅ 7 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`. `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` — `✅ No changeset declares a 'major' bump`.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 8 changed paths — `✅ NOT GOVERNED`.

Merged (not rebased) with `origin/main` twice while in flight, most recently at `d717e8bc3`; the whole list above is the post-merge run on `8a409182a`.

## Scope

Diff is exactly 8 files across `packages/plugin-detail`, `packages/app-shell` and one changeset. Not touched: `headerColor` (#6178 stays open and unclaimed), `filterMode` (#5891), and anything `$expand` / `$select` — #7230 remains open and shares `RecordDetailView.tsx`. For whoever picks those up: the lines this PR moved in that file are `:1885` and `:1914`, both inside the `synthParts.sections` block, nowhere near `buildExpandFields`.

Draft on purpose — the PM lands it.
